name: Gas-phase amino acid conformer benchmark
description: A curated set of benchmark structures and conformational landscapes of amino acids in the gas phase for validating quantum chemistry and ML methods against spectroscopic references.
evaluation_method: energy RMSE (kcal/mol), geometry RMSD (Å), and relative energy ranking accuracy
reputation: Respected in computational chemistry as a reference for validating quantum-chemical methods and ML potentials on amino-acid gas-phase conformers.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; gas-phase spectra-based references mean results do not directly transfer to solvated/biological environments; typically small/curated set aimed at method validation rather than large-scale ML training.
